issues.detail: The instructions do not cover all error scenarios and edge cases, such as handling missing CUDA or corrupted checkpoints.

scenarios.name: custom-cnn-cifar10-onnx
scenarios.rationale: Response B better meets the rubric, covering persistent workers, gradient clipping, and eval mode, while Response A lacks these and also misses compile, dtype, and export.

scenarios.name: bert-sentiment-finetune-onnx
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but omits freezing layers; Response B lacks the required training loop, mixed‑precision, freezing, and dynamo export.

scenarios.name: distributed-resnet-mixed-precision
scenarios.rationale: Response B covers more rubric items, including dtype=bfloat16, persistent_workers, and mixed‑precision handling, while Response A omits persistent_workers, dtype specification, and model.eval() after training.
